scope: New independent recomputation of frozen14B outputs, no new inference or independent labels
cautions: Each task contains one developer and one officially unresolved candidate; these are functional proxy labels, not maintainer/rationale truth.
The conditional task sign test is exploratory and does not model repository-level dependence.
A non-significant test does not establish equality or absence of an effect.
No settings were chosen using this reanalysis. Existing bootstrap CIs are retained.
